notes: Facts confirmed 2026-09-10 from the church's own site, which describes it as 'an independent Baptist church in the northwest Tucson area' - so the affiliation is Independent Baptist, not SBC. Address 8811 W Avra Valley Rd, Marana AZ 85653 (unchanged, geocode already verified). Sunday worship 10:30am. The staff page names Pastor Tim Walker as the preaching pastor, plus Steven Morris as Pastor Emeritus (not recorded as an active preaching pastor - check whether he still takes the pulpit before attributing any sermon to him) and an unnamed youth pastor. Sermons are posted to YouTube at @sunandshieldbaptistchurch (channel UCnLOkkRIj6XMiV1EJRtSzjw) and streamed on Facebook; caption availability not yet tested.
